<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='petal' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6b8a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e0245e'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='petalLight' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9eb5'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff5c85'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='leaf' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7be07b'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2fa82f'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='stem' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#5ec85e'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2e9e2e'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- stem -->
  <rect x='46' y='48' width='8' height='40' rx='4' fill='url(#stem)'/>

  <!-- left leaf -->
  <path d='M50 78 C36 74 24 62 22 50 C34 54 46 64 50 72 Z' fill='url(#leaf)'/>
  <!-- right leaf -->
  <path d='M50 82 C64 78 76 66 78 54 C66 58 54 68 50 76 Z' fill='url(#leaf)'/>

  <!-- tulip cup: left petal -->
  <path d='M30 48 C28 30 34 20 42 18 C44 30 44 40 42 50 Z' fill='url(#petalLight)'/>
  <!-- right petal -->
  <path d='M70 48 C72 30 66 20 58 18 C56 30 56 40 58 50 Z' fill='url(#petalLight)'/>
  <!-- center petal -->
  <path d='M38 50 C38 28 44 16 50 14 C56 16 62 28 62 50 Z' fill='url(#petal)'/>
  <!-- base of cup -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='16' ry='6' fill='#e0245e'/>

  <!-- petal highlight -->
  <path d='M46 22 C47 30 47 40 46 46' stroke='#ffb3c6' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>

title: Snowflake
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <!-- Main 6 arms -->
    <g stroke="#7fdbff" stroke-width="4.5" fill="none">
      <!-- vertical -->
      <line x1="50" y1="12" x2="50" y2="88"/>
      <!-- diagonals -->
      <line x1="17" y1="31" x2="83" y2="69"/>
      <line x1="83" y1="31" x2="17" y2="69"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Branch details on each arm -->
    <g stroke="#a0e8ff" stroke-width="3.5" fill="none">
      <!-- vertical top branches -->
      <line x1="50" y1="25" x2="40" y2="17"/>
      <line x1="50" y1="25" x2="60" y2="17"/>
      <line x1="50" y1="38" x2="43" y2="33"/>
      <line x1="50" y1="38" x2="57" y2="33"/>
      <!-- vertical bottom branches -->
      <line x1="50" y1="75" x2="40" y2="83"/>
      <line x1="50" y1="75" x2="60" y2="83"/>
      <line x1="50" y1="62" x2="43" y2="67"/>
      <line x1="50" y1="62" x2="57" y2="67"/>
      <!-- diagonal top-left arm branches -->
      <line x1="30" y1="38" x2="27" y2="27"/>
      <line x1="30" y1="38" x2="39" y2="29"/>
      <line x1="22" y1="34" x2="20" y2="26"/>
      <!-- diagonal top-right arm branches -->
      <line x1="70" y1="38" x2="73" y2="27"/>
      <line x1="70" y1="38" x2="61" y2="29"/>
      <line x1="78" y1="34" x2="80" y2="26"/>
      <!-- diagonal bottom-left arm branches -->
      <line x1="30" y1="62" x2="27" y2="73"/>
      <line x1="30" y1="62" x2="39" y2="71"/>
      <line x1="22" y1="66" x2="20" y2="74"/>
      <!-- diagonal bottom-right arm branches -->
      <line x1="70" y1="62" x2="73" y2="73"/>
      <line x1="70" y1="62" x2="61" y2="71"/>
      <line x1="78" y1="66" x2="80" y2="74"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Center hexagon -->
    <polygon points="50,42 57,46 57,54 50,58 43,54 43,46" fill="#d4f4ff" stroke="#7fdbff" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- Center sparkle -->
    <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="3" fill="#ffffff"/>
    <!-- Tip dots -->
    <g fill="#d4f4ff">
      <circle cx="50" cy="12" r="3.5"/>
      <circle cx="50" cy="88" r="3.5"/>
      <circle cx="17" cy="31" r="3.5"/>
      <circle cx="83" cy="69" r="3.5"/>
      <circle cx="83" cy="31" r="3.5"/>
      <circle cx="17" cy="69" r="3.5"/>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>

title: Snowflake
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='ice1' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#a8e6ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#4fc3f7'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='ice2' x1='0' y1='1' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e1f5fe'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#81d4fa'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='ice3' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b3e5fc'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Main six arms -->
  <!-- Vertical arm -->
  <rect x='46' y='14' width='8' height='72' rx='4' fill='url(#ice1)'/>
  <!-- Diagonal arms (rotated) -->
  <rect x='46' y='14' width='8' height='72' rx='4' fill='url(#ice2)' transform='rotate(60 50 50)'/>
  <rect x='46' y='14' width='8' height='72' rx='4' fill='url(#ice2)' transform='rotate(120 50 50)'/>
  <rect x='46' y='14' width='8' height='72' rx='4' fill='url(#ice2)' transform='rotate(-60 50 50)'/>
  <rect x='46' y='14' width='8' height='72' rx='4' fill='url(#ice2)' transform='rotate(-120 50 50)'/>

  <!-- Branch details on each arm (small V shapes) -->
  <!-- Vertical top branch -->
  <rect x='38' y='22' width='5' height='16' rx='2.5' fill='url(#ice3)' transform='rotate(-35 40.5 30)'/>
  <rect x='58' y='22' width='5' height='16' rx='2.5' fill='url(#ice3)' transform='rotate(35 59.5 30)'/>
  <!-- Vertical bottom branch -->
  <rect x='38' y='62' width='5' height='16' rx='2.5' fill='url(#ice3)' transform='rotate(35 40.5 70)'/>
  <rect x='58' y='62' width='5' height='16' rx='2.5' fill='url(#ice3)' transform='rotate(-35 59.5 70)'/>

  <!-- Branch 60deg top-right -->
  <rect x='52' y='22' width='5' height='16' rx='2.5' fill='url(#ice3)' transform='rotate(25 54 38)'/>
  <rect x='72' y='42' width='5' height='16' rx='2.5' fill='url(#ice3)' transform='rotate(85 74 54)'/>
  <!-- Branch 120deg top-left -->
  <rect x='22' y='48' width='5' height='16' rx='2.5' fill='url(#ice3)' transform='rotate(-85 24 62)'/>
  <rect x='28' y='26' width='5' height='16' rx='2.5' fill='url(#ice3)' transform='rotate(-25 30 40)'/>
  <!-- Branch -60deg bottom-right -->
  <rect x='52' y='62' width='5' height='16' rx='2.5' fill='url(#ice3)' transform='rotate(-25 54 70)'/>
  <rect x='72' y='42' width='5' height='16' rx='2.5' fill='url(#ice3)' transform='rotate(-85 74 54)'/>
  <!-- Branch -120deg bottom-left -->
  <rect x='22' y='48' width='5' height='16' rx='2.5' fill='url(#ice3)' transform='rotate(85 24 62)'/>
  <rect x='28' y='62' width='5' height='16' rx='2.5' fill='url(#ice3)' transform='rotate(25 30 70)'/>

  <!-- Center hexagon -->
  <polygon points='50,42 57,46 57,54 50,58 43,54 43,46' fill='url(#ice3)' stroke='#e1f5fe' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Inner glow dot -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='4' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- Small frost tips on each arm end -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='14' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='86' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='81' cy='32' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='19' cy='32' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='81' cy='68' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='19' cy='68' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
</svg>

title: Sparkly trumpet
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='100' height='100'>
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <g fill="#FFE600">
    <polygon points="18,12 20,18 26,20 20,22 18,28 16,22 10,20 16,18"/>
    <polygon points="82,8 83.5,12 88,13.5 83.5,15 82,19 80.5,15 76,13.5 80.5,12"/>
    <polygon points="12,65 13.5,69 18,70.5 13.5,72 12,76 10.5,72 6,70.5 10.5,69"/>
    <polygon points="88,55 89.5,59 94,60.5 89.5,62 88,66 86.5,62 82,60.5 86.5,59"/>
    <polygon points="72,82 73,85 76,86 73,87 72,90 71,87 68,86 71,85"/>
    <polygon points="28,88 29,91 32,92 29,93 28,96 27,93 24,92 27,91"/>
    <circle cx="50" cy="6" r="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="8" cy="40" r="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="92" cy="32" r="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="60" cy="94" r="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Mouthpiece -->
  <rect x="10" y="45" width="8" height="10" rx="2" fill="#F5A623" stroke="#FFD280" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <rect x="8" y="44" width="5" height="12" rx="1.5" fill="#FFD280" stroke="#FFE8B0" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Main tube -->
  <rect x="17" y="46" width="30" height="8" rx="3" fill="#E8912D"/>
  <rect x="17" y="46" width="30" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#FFD280" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Valves (three pistons) -->
  <g>
    <rect x="27" y="38" width="4" height="10" rx="1.5" fill="#D97A1E"/>
    <rect x="26" y="35" width="6" height="4" rx="1.5" fill="#FFD280" stroke="#FFE8B0" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="29" cy="37" r="1.2" fill="#FFF3C4"/>

    <rect x="34" y="37" width="4" height="11" rx="1.5" fill="#D97A1E"/>
    <rect x="33" y="34" width="6" height="4" rx="1.5" fill="#FFD280" stroke="#FFE8B0" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="36" cy="36" r="1.2" fill="#FFF3C4"/>

    <rect x="41" y="38" width="4" height="10" rx="1.5" fill="#D97A1E"/>
    <rect x="40" y="35" width="6" height="4" rx="1.5" fill="#FFD280" stroke="#FFE8B0" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="43" cy="37" r="1.2" fill="#FFF3C4"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bell curve / flare -->
  <path d="M47 46 Q58 42 68 34 Q74 29 78 22 Q82 18 86 20 Q90 22 88 30 Q86 40 78 48 Q72 54 64 56 Q56 58 47 54 Z"
        fill="#F5A623" stroke="#FFD280" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <!-- Bell opening -->
  <ellipse cx="82" cy="29" rx="6" ry="10" fill="#FFC940" stroke="#FFE8B0" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <ellipse cx="82" cy="29" rx="3.5" ry="6" fill="#FFF3C4" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- Highlights on tube -->
  <rect x="20" y="47" width="12" height="2" rx="1" fill="#FFF3C4" opacity="0.5"/>
  <rect x="38" y="48" width="8" height="1.5" rx="0.75" fill="#FFF3C4" opacity="0.4"/>

  <!-- Water key / small loop -->
  <path d="M58 54 Q60 58 64 57" fill="none" stroke="#FFD280" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>

title: Glowing snowflake
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e0f7ff' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#a0e0ff' stop-opacity='0.4'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#60c0ff' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <filter id='blur'>
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation='2.5'/>
    </filter>
    <filter id='softglow'>
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation='1.5' result='blur'/>
      <feMerge>
        <feMergeNode in='blur'/>
        <feMergeNode in='SourceGraphic'/>

    </filter>

  <!-- Outer glow halo -->

  <line x1='40' y1='61' x2='40' y2='45' stroke='#ffaeae' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- door handle -->

  <circle cx='26' cy='70' r='4' fill='#c9c9dc' stroke='#f0f0ff' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='70' r='9' fill='#2b2b3c' stroke='#8a8aa8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='70' r='4' fill='#c9c9dc' stroke='#f0f0ff' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- spokes hint -->
  <g stroke='#6f6f92' stroke-width='1'>
    <line x1='26' y1='66' x2='26' y2='74'/>
    <line x1='22' y1='70' x2='30' y2='70'/>
    <line x1='72' y1='66' x2='72' y2='74'/>
